name: Sharpen
description: Add 4 to this Power glyph's value.
mechanics: value += 4
quote: A keen edge never asks permission.

name: Fortify
description: Add 6 to this Defense or Heal glyph's value.
mechanics: value += 6; does nothing on Weak or Vulnerable glyphs

name: Round Up
description: Raise this glyph's value to the next multiple of 5.
mechanics: value = next multiple of 5 above it (+1 to +5)

name: Double or Halve
description: 60% chance to double this glyph's value; 40% chance to halve it.
mechanics: 60% value x2, 40% value // 2; seeded by the match

name: Snowball
description: Add 3 to this glyph's value, and 3 more for every earlier use of this perk.
mechanics: value += 3 * (uses so far + 1): +3, +6, +9, +12
quote: Every avalanche starts with a single flake.

name: Blood
description: Add 15 to this glyph's value, but you lose 8 HP (never below 1).
mechanics: value += 15; caster HP -= 8, minimum 1
quote: Power is always paid for in red.

name: Amplify
description: Raise this glyph's value by half.
mechanics: value x1.5, rounded down

name: Overcharge
description: Multiply this glyph's value by 2.5. One use.
mechanics: value x2.5, rounded down
quote: The circuit sings once, then never again.

name: -ING-
description: Turn this glyph into ING and raise its value by 7.
mechanics: letters = ING, value += 7; does nothing if it already reads ING
quote: Action is a verb with a suffix.

name: -ER-
description: Turn this glyph into ER and raise its value by 5.
mechanics: letters = ER, value += 5; does nothing if it already reads ER

name: -RE-
description: Turn this glyph into RE and raise its value by 5.
mechanics: letters = RE, value += 5; does nothing if it already reads RE

name: -ED-
description: Turn this glyph into ED and raise its value by 5.
mechanics: letters = ED, value += 5; does nothing if it already reads ED

name: Pluralize
description: Turn this glyph into S and raise its value by 3.
mechanics: letters = S, value += 3; does nothing if it already reads S

name: -QU-
description: Turn this glyph into QU and raise its value by 18.
mechanics: letters = QU, value += 18; does nothing if it already reads QU

name: Vowel Shift
description: Turn this glyph into a random vowel and raise its value by 2.
mechanics: letters = random vowel (A E I O U) other than the current one (seeded); value += 2
quote: When words fail, try an A.

name: Consonant Shift
description: Turn this glyph into a random common consonant and raise its value by 4.
mechanics: letters = random of S T N R L D other than the current one (seeded); value += 4
quote: Swap the bones, keep the muscle.

name: Wild Power
description: Turn this Defense or Heal glyph into a Power glyph that deals damage, +4 value.
mechanics: type = POWER, effect = DAMAGE, value += 4; not on Weak/Vulnerable glyphs
quote: The best defence is a good offence.

name: Wild Skill
description: Turn this Power glyph into a random Defense or Heal glyph, +6 value.
mechanics: type = SKILL, effect = DEFENSE or HEAL (seeded), value += 6

name: Hex
description: Your opponent becomes Weak for 3 turns: their Power glyphs lose 25%.
mechanics: opponent gets WEAK for 3 turns (their next two casts); the glyph is unchanged
quote: Your strength is mine to borrow.

name: Expose
description: Your opponent becomes Vulnerable for 3 turns, starting with this word.
mechanics: opponent gets VULNERABLE for 3 turns (this cast and your next); the glyph is unchanged

name: Linger
description: Your opponent's statuses last 2 more turns. No statuses? They become Weak for 2 turns.
mechanics: each opponent status turns_left += 2; with none, opponent gets WEAK for 2 turns; the glyph is unchanged

name: Erase
description: Remove this glyph from your deck for good and draw a replacement.
mechanics: glyph leaves the match (hand and every pile); draw 1

name: Redraw
description: Discard this glyph and draw a new one with +5 value.
mechanics: glyph goes to the discard pile; draw 1; the drawn glyph's value += 5 (not on Weak/Vulnerable)
quote: The next letter could be the one.

name: Fresh Start
description: Discard your whole hand and draw a new one; the new glyphs get +3 value.
mechanics: discard the hand; draw up to hand size; drawn glyphs' value += 3 (not on Weak/Vulnerable)
quote: Burn the page, write a better one.

name: Last Letter +9
description: Gains 9 if this glyph ends the word.
mechanics: bonus slot: +9 when last in the word

name: First Letter +9
description: Gains 9 if this glyph starts the word.
mechanics: bonus slot: +9 when first in the word

name: Last Letter x2
description: Double this glyph's value if it ends the word.
mechanics: bonus slot: x2 when last in the word
quote: The final word is the heaviest.

name: First Letter x2
description: Double this glyph's value if it starts the word.
mechanics: bonus slot: x2 when first in the word

name: Vowel Start +12
description: Gains 12 if the word starts with a vowel.
mechanics: bonus slot: +12 when the word's first letter is A E I O U

name: Five Letters +8
description: Gains 8 if the word has exactly 5 letters.
mechanics: bonus slot: +8 when the word is 5 letters long

name: Matching Ends x3
description: Triple this glyph's value if the word's first and last letters match.
mechanics: bonus slot: x3 when first letter == last letter (2+ letters)

name: Quick Jab
description: Gains 14 if the word has 3 letters or fewer.
mechanics: bonus slot: +14 when the word is at most 3 letters

name: Twin Letters
description: Gains 14 if the word has the same letter twice in a row.
mechanics: bonus slot: +14 when the word contains a double letter (LL, EE...)

name: Late Bloomer
description: Gains 50% if this is the 3rd glyph of the word or later.
mechanics: bonus slot: value x1.5 (rounded down) at position 3 or later
quote: Good things come to those who wait.

name: Long Word
description: Double this glyph's value if the word has 6 or more letters.
mechanics: bonus slot: x2 when the word is 6+ letters

name: Onslaught
description: Gains 3 for every Power glyph in the word.
mechanics: bonus slot: + 3 x number of POWER glyphs in the word

name: Lexicon
description: Gains 2 for every letter in the word after the second.
mechanics: bonus slot: + 2 x (word length - 2)

name: Climber
description: Gains 3 for every glyph before this one in the word, up to 15.
mechanics: bonus slot: + 3 x (position - 1), at most +15
quote: Each step higher, each blow harder.

name: Desperation
description: Double this glyph's value while you have 30% HP or less.
mechanics: bonus slot: x2 when the caster's HP <= 30% of max

name: Executioner
description: Triple this glyph's value while your opponent has 40% HP or less.
mechanics: bonus slot: x3 when the target's HP <= 40% of max

name: Grand Finale
description: Triple this glyph's value if it ends a word of 5 or more letters.
mechanics: bonus slot: x3 when last in a word of 5+ letters
